files.contract: Structured optional command permissions and hook wiring. files.contract: Rebuildable root and vendor target outputs, capture packet logs, Python caches and local overrides are ignored. Source, canonical patches and retained fixture inputs remain tracked.

files.contract: All-feature dependency policy rejects stock counterparts of renamed forks, permits reviewed license expressions and one pinned Git source.
